# Ale Alberga

> Portfolio site for Alessandro (Ale) Alberga, a Sydney-based Senior Software Engineer specialising in Flutter, front-end architecture, and full-stack development.

Ale is currently leading front-end app development at Mates.com, a greenfield startup. Previously he worked at InfoTrack (senior engineer, then team leadership) and Allon Pacific. He specialises in JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, C#, and Dart, with cloud and database experience in AWS, Postgres, and MongoDB.

## Site sections

- [Home](https://alealberga.com/) — introduction, specialisations, achievements, employment history, hobbies, and a contact form
- [Blog](https://alealberga.com/blogs) — writing on software engineering, Flutter, front-end architecture, and AI (new posts in progress)
